texts.orig: The of this section is construct the regular magnitude-path spectral sequence; in analogy with the magnitude-path spectral sequence developed in [Asa23] To do so; it shall be more convenient to use the categorical language; and to generalize the framework of eulerian magnitude homology to quivers. In the first subsection we introduce the tool of injective nerves of categories; and then we shall apply it to the reachable categories; getting the regular magnitude-path spectral sequence. As an application of the construction; we shall provide some computations of regular homology of regularly diagonal graphs. goal path
